svg.title: Cecil rolls down a clean ramp towards cracked paving.
svg.desc: Cecil confidently announces that the ceremonial route is valid while rolling down the convoy ramp. The painted line ahead continues over jagged paving unsuitable for the robot's small wheels.
svg.text: Page 2, panel 2 · Low medium shot from behind Cecil's deployment ramp
